evidence: Labeled Validation; modifies block connection and UTXO flush/hashing logic in src/validation.cpp during Initial Block Download.
rationale: Verifies compiled AssumeUTXO commitments against the UTXO set reconstructed during normal IBD to provide crowdsourced verification of baked-in snapshot data (#32377). While this strengthens independent verification of developer-provided commitments and alerts users on mismatch, it does not fix an active defect or consensus hazard, making review worthwhile but deferrable.
